name: Cat's Arrest ~In Goumon ni Naku Bishimai~
original_name: CAT'S ARREST ～淫拷問に啼く美姉妹～
source:
In order to cover up her boyfriend's failed criminal investigation, a woman single-handedly marches into the Department of Defense to overcome all his opponents only to be captured by them. Three sisters are captured one after another and sentenced to perverted and cruel sexual torture only to slowly become their sex slaves. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE036552.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
一名女子为掩盖男友刑事调查失败，单枪匹马闯入国防部，战胜了所有对手，却被他们抓获。三姐妹相继被捕，被判以变态残酷的性折磨，却慢慢沦为她们的性奴隶。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE036552.html]DLsite English[/url]]
